reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin health-check utility that validates manifests, patches, entry points, builds, packages, fresh-profile installation, configuration, and selected environment conditions through a CLI and agent-callable tool.

summaries.zh: 用于通过命令行或智能体工具检查 DeepSeek Harness 插件的清单、构建、打包、安装、配置和环境状态。
summaries.en: A CLI and agent-callable utility for checking DeepSeek Harness plugin manifests, builds, packages, installations, configuration, and selected environment conditions.

capabilities: reads plugin manifests and profile files
runs build, packaging, installation, and configuration verification commands
creates and inspects a fresh DeepSeek Harness profile
performs environment diagnostics and heuristic source checks
